descriptions.preferred: The leaves have a base color of rich green which is marked with white variegations. Some leaves are all white, while others have only a few white flecks. The main pattern is white or cream cut-in a portion of the green leaf. In these leaves, the variegated portion is curved or sickle-shaped. Often the green leaf is stippled with tiny specks of white, forming a solid pattern with the green showing through from beneath. The medium-sized leaf usually has five lobes. Each lobe generally is triangular-ovate, but all lobes are irregularly curved or sickle-shaped. As new leaves emerge, the variegation has a definite pink tone which soon changes to white or cream. This cultivar forms a tall shrub, reaching up to 16 ft. (5 m) high. It is not a rapid grower and should have some protection from the hot afternoon sun. Acer tschonoskii Tschonoski's maple This small graceful snakebark maple is native to Japan, growing in the subalpine mountain forests at elevations of 4550-8125 ft. (1400-1500 m) above sea level. It forms a large shrub or small tree up to 16-23 ft. (5-7 m) tall, and makes a pleasant choice in a mixed landscape. The small, round, shallowly five-lobed leaves have very coarsely toothed margins and shortly pointed tips. The leaves are green with rusty brown hairs beneath. Fall colors are yellow to gold, sometimes pink tinged, but not outstanding. This species is one of the easiest, hardiest, and most tolerant maple species to grow. It does not like alkaline soils.

sources.title: 秋风锦 Acer Pictum 'Akikaze Nishiki'
sources.description: 秋风锦距今已经有 100多年的历史，最早记录可追溯到1882年，非常的耐热，是迄今为止最耐热的锦叶品种。秋风锦原本归属于元宝枫，之后矢野正善大师将其归为蝙蝠枫。在早春也是绿色和亮粉红色的，随后粉色部分会蜕变成奶油白。夏季白色部分还会适当反绿成浅白的绿色，然后原来绿色的部分会变成更深的绿色。秋季是橙红色。秋风锦的生长速度非常快，成年树高6-7米。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片底色为浓绿色，并带有白色斑锦。有些叶片几乎全白，另一些则只有少量白色斑点。其主要斑纹类型为在绿色叶面上切入状分布的白色或奶油色区域，这些斑锦部分常呈弯曲或镰刀状。绿色部分常又密布细小白点，形成近乎连续的斑锦效果，而下层仍可透出绿色。中等大小的叶片通常为 5 裂；各裂片多呈三角状卵形，但整体常不规则弯曲或呈镰刀状。新叶展开时斑锦带有明显粉色调，不久即转为白色或奶油色。该品种可形成高大灌木，高可达 16 英尺（5 米）。其生长速度不快，宜避免午后烈日直晒。 随后可辨识内容转为 Acer tschonoskii（Tschonoski's maple）的描述：这是一种优雅的小型蛇皮槭，原产日本，生于海拔约 4550-8125 英尺（1400-1500 米）的亚高山林地。植株可形成大型灌木或小乔木，高约 16-23 英尺（5-7 米），适合用于混合景观配置。叶片较小、近圆形、浅裂 5 裂，边缘具粗锯齿，先端短尖；叶面绿色，叶背带锈褐色毛。秋色为黄色至金黄色，有时略带粉色，但并不十分突出。该种是较易栽培、耐寒性和适应性都较强的槭树之一，但不喜碱性土壤。 其后原文为耐寒分区图、苗圃来源、术语表、参考书目及索引，且 OCR 噪声极重，此处不作臆测性逐项翻译。
